title: Still deciding on this one.....
text: I did look up the value of the products in the box and if I were to have gone out and bought these items on my own I would have paid more. That being said, if it were not for the fact that I have a multi dog household ranging from a 7lbs to 54lbs and a variety of likes and dislikes to match I would have probably been very disappointed in this box. Even with that the hard plastic toy that came was turned down by everyone. The treats were liked by at least one dog though. Holding out to see what next months box is like, if yet another unwanted toy or similar disappointment is enclosed will cancel.
label: neutral
